implemented_requirements.evidence: claw.py defines a SWINGING state with _swing() that oscillates angle between +/- SWING_ANGLE_LIMIT using swing_speed.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can time a grab to collect objects
implemented_requirements.evidence: claw.py launch() switches state to EXTENDING; update() processes extension and grabs the first intersecting object.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each object has a value and takes time to reel in
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py OBJECT_STATS includes value and weight for each kind; claw._retract() uses held.weight to compute retract speed, making heavier objects slower.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Level ends when time runs out or the minimum gold value is met
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game class defines time_left but never updates it or checks against target_gold; no level‑completion logic is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display the position of the claw and objects, updating after each grab
implemented_requirements.evidence: claw.draw() renders the rope and claw head and draws the held object, but there is no code that draws the field objects; Game.draw() is missing.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Introduce ascending difficulty with more obstacles or tighter time limits
implemented_requirements.evidence: level.py uses settings.level_config() which tightens time_limit, raises target_gold, and adds more TNT/rocks per level.

critical_issues: Game class lacks update() and draw() implementations, so the main loop never updates time, checks win/lose conditions, or renders objects/HUD.
objects.py does not define the base GameObject class or any concrete object classes; gold.py references undefined GameObject and pygame.
Missing imports in gold.py (pygame, settings) cause NameError at import time.
No scoring or target‑gold tracking logic; score variable in Game is never modified.
Time limit is never decremented; level termination conditions are absent.
No rendering of non‑held objects (gold, rocks, diamonds, TNT, mystery bags) on the screen.
The game never transitions between MENU, PLAYING, LEVEL_COMPLETE, GAME_OVER, VICTORY states because the required state changes are not coded.
judge.summary: The repository contains a partially implemented claw mechanic and level generation with difficulty scaling, but the core game loop, object definitions, rendering, scoring, and level‑completion logic are missing or incomplete. Consequently the program would not run as a functional Gold Miner game, leading to a fail verdict.
